defect_found: The compose healthcheck self-probes with ["/control","healthcheck"], a path from the previous distroless image. The merc image placed its binary at /app/merc, so every probe failed with 'stat /control: no such file or directory' and both containers sat unhealthy while the site served 200 externally. Fixed with a symlink rather than by editing compose, so the same image satisfies the existing healthcheck contract and rollback stays trivial.
